title: Maharashtra FDA suspends 21 food outlets, recovers ₹1.57 lakh in penalties
description:
The Maharashtra Food and Drugs Administration (FDA) on Saturday said it inspected multiple establishments at the state's Vidhan Bhavan premises and recovered a penalty of Rs 67,000.
The FDA said it also inspected 15 establishments in the state-owned Air India building in the area and recovered a penalty of Rs 90,000. While two improvement notices were served, the registration certificate of Shri Ashok Rajpat Gupta (Fresh-N-Juice Stall) there was suspended.
The regulator said it has suspended the licences of 21 establishments, including five from Mumbai, for violating food safety norms.
"In the Vidhan Bhavan premises, 13 establishments were inspected, and a penalty of Rs 67,000 was recovered under Section 69 (of the FSSAI Act)," the agency said.
